title: Godot 4.4 editor crashing on Metal renderer with CompressedCubemap Panorama Skybox: "Texture Descriptor Validation MTLTextureDescriptor width must equal height for cube textures."
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable 4.4 Stable
- Not reproducable 4.3

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.3.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 Max (Apple8) - Apple M2 Max (12 threads)

### Issue description

```
-[MTLTextureDescriptorInternal validateWithDevice:]:1405: failed assertion `Texture Descriptor Validation
MTLTextureDescriptor width must equal height for cube textures.
```

Here is the crash:
